biography:
Adam and the Ants were a British rock band active during the late 1970s and early 1980s. The original group, which lasted from 1977 to 1982, became notable as a cult band during the transition from the late-1970s punk rock era to the post-punk and New Wave era and were noted for their high camp and overtly sexualised stage performances and use of Burundi drums. By the end of 1979, the line-up of musicians Dave Barbarossa, Matthew Ashman and Leigh Gorman – all of whom left the band in January 1980 at the suggestion of then-de facto manager Malcolm McLaren, to form the instrumentalist personnel of the controversial Bow Wow Wow.

The second incarnation of Adam and the Ants featured guitarist Marco Pirroni and drummer/record producer Chris Hughes and lasted from about February 1980 to March 1982 and achieved major commercial success in the UK as early leaders of the burgeoning UK New Romantic movement. Both versions of the band were led by singer and chief songwriter Adam Ant.

discogs.profile:
Adam and the Ants (sometimes stylized with a backwards "D" in "ADAM" & a "hard", zig-zagged "S" in "ANTS" - making it appear as a backwards "Z") were an English punk, later turned new wave band, active during the late 1970s and early 1980s. The group, originally just known as The Ants, lasted from 1977 to 1982, existed in two incarnations, both fronted by [a10380] (real name [a671330]). The first, founded in April 1977, achieved considerable cult popularity during the transition from the punk rock era to the post-punk and new wave era and were noted for their high camp and overtly sexualised stage performances and songs. The band over the years featured Paul Flanagan, [a523615], Mark Ryan (The Kid), Johnny Bivouac and Andy Warren. The final lineup of this first incarnation - Dave Barbarossa, Matthew Ashman and Leigh Gorman - left the band in January 1980 at the suggestion of then-de facto manager [a24495], to form the instrumentalist personnel of the controversial [a10381].

The second incarnation of Adam And The Ants featured guitarist Marco Pirroni, drummer-producer Chris Hughes, drummer Terry Lee Mail and bassists Kevin Mooney and Gary Tibbs. The band was noted for its use of Burundi style drumming and lasted from February 1980 to March 1982 and achieved major commercial success in the UK and abroad.

Marco continued to collaborate with Adam Ant throughout his solo career, until shortly after his comeback in 2010.

theaudiodb.biography_en:
Adam and the Ants were a British rock band active during the late 1970s and early 1980s. The original group, which lasted from 1977 to 1982, became notable as a cult band during the transition from the late-1970s punk rock era to the post-punk and New Wave era and were noted for their high camp and overtly sexualised stage performances and use of Burundi drums. By the end of 1979, the line-up of musicians Dave Barbarossa, Matthew Ashman and Leigh Gorman – all of whom left the band in January 1980 at the suggestion of then-de facto manager Malcolm McLaren, to form the instrumentalist personnel of the controversial Bow Wow Wow.

The second incarnation of Adam and the Ants featured guitarist Marco Pirroni and drummer/record producer Chris Hughes and lasted from about February 1980 to March 1982 and achieved major commercial success in the UK as early leaders of the burgeoning UK New Romantic movement. theaudiodb.biography_es:
Adam and the Ants fue una banda de rock británica activa a finales de los 70 y principios de los 80. El grupo original, que duró de 1977 a 1982, se hizo notable como banda de culto durante la transición de la era del punk rock de finales de la década de 1970 a la era del post-punk y la New Wave, y se destacó por su alto nivel y sus actuaciones en el escenario abiertamente sexualizadas. A finales de 1979, la formación de los músicos Dave Barbarossa, Matthew Ashman y Leigh Gorman, todos los cuales dejaron la banda en enero de 1980 por sugerencia del entonces manager de facto Malcolm McLaren, para formar el personal instrumentista de Bow Wow Wow.
La segunda encarnación de Adam and the Ants contó con el guitarrista Marco Pirroni y el baterista / productor discográfico Chris Hughes y duró aproximadamente desde febrero de 1980 hasta marzo de 1982 y logró un gran éxito comercial en el Reino Unido como los primeros líderes del floreciente movimiento de los Nuevos Romanticos. Ambas versiones de la banda fueron dirigidas por el cantante y compositor principal Adam Ant.
theaudiodb.biography_nl:
Adam and the Ants was een Britse New romantic-punkgroep, opgericht in 1977 in Londen, Engeland: Adam Ant (zang, gitaar), geboren als Stuart Leslie Goddard op 03-11-1954 in Marylebone, Londen, Engeland. Overige bandleden: Marco Pirroni (gitaar; ex Siouxsie & The Banshees), Kevin Mooney (basgitaar). Terry Lee Miall en Chris “Merrick” Hughes (beiden drums).

Mooney stapt op in 1981 en wordt vervangen door Gary Tibbs. De drie oorspronkelijke leden van de groep gitarist Matthew Ashman (overleden op 22-11-1995 aan de gevolgen van diabetes), bassist Leigh Gorman en drummer Dave Barbarossa formeren in januari 1980 de Britse new wave band Bow Wow Wow.

Adam Ant gaat vanaf 2 mei 1982 solo verder. Hij heeft dit besluit genomen nadat Miall en Tibbs zijn groep hebben verlaten. Acteert in de films Slam Dance (1987), World Gone Wild (1988) en is te zien in verschillende televisieseries.
theaudiodb.biography_pt: Adam and the Ants foi uma banda de rock britânica formada na cidade de Londres, em 1977 . O grupo original, que durou de 1977 a 1982, tornou-se notável durante a transição do punk rock do final da década de 1970 para o pós-punk e a new wave. Eram conhecidos por performances de palco abertamente sexualizadas e uso de tambores do Burundi. Dave Barbarossa, Matthew Ashman e Leigh Gorman, da primeira formação, deixaram a banda em janeiro de 1980, por sugestão do então empresário Malcolm McLaren, para formar a banda Bow Wow Wow. A segunda formação teve o guitarrista Marco Pirroni e o baterista/produtor musical Chris Hughes e foi de Fevereiro de 1980 a Março de 1982 e alcançou grande sucesso comercial no Reino Unido como primeiros líderes do movimento New Romantic. Ambas as formações foram lideradas pelo cantor e compositor Adam Ant.

theaudiodb.biography_en:
Adam and the Ants were a British rock band active during the late 1970s and early 1980s. The original group, which lasted from 1977 to 1982, became notable as a cult band during the transition from the late-1970s punk rock era to the post-punk and New Wave era and were noted for their high camp and overtly sexualised stage performances and use of Burundi drums. By the end of 1979, the line-up of musicians Dave Barbarossa, Matthew Ashman and Leigh Gorman – all of whom left the band in January 1980 at the suggestion of then-de facto manager Malcolm McLaren, to form the instrumentalist personnel of the controversial Bow Wow Wow.

The second incarnation of Adam and the Ants featured guitarist Marco Pirroni and drummer/record producer Chris Hughes and lasted from about February 1980 to March 1982 and achieved major commercial success in the UK as early leaders of the burgeoning UK New Romantic movement. Both versions of the band were led by singer and chief songwriter Adam Ant.
theaudiodb.biography_es:
Adam and the Ants fue una banda de rock británica activa a finales de los 70 y principios de los 80. El grupo original, que duró de 1977 a 1982, se hizo notable como banda de culto durante la transición de la era del punk rock de finales de la década de 1970 a la era del post-punk y la New Wave, y se destacó por su alto nivel y sus actuaciones en el escenario abiertamente sexualizadas. A finales de 1979, la formación de los músicos Dave Barbarossa, Matthew Ashman y Leigh Gorman, todos los cuales dejaron la banda en enero de 1980 por sugerencia del entonces manager de facto Malcolm McLaren, para formar el personal instrumentista de Bow Wow Wow.
La segunda encarnación de Adam and the Ants contó con el guitarrista Marco Pirroni y el baterista / productor discográfico Chris Hughes y duró aproximadamente desde febrero de 1980 hasta marzo de 1982 y logró un gran éxito comercial en el Reino Unido como los primeros líderes del floreciente movimiento de los Nuevos Romanticos. Ambas versiones de la banda fueron dirigidas por el cantante y compositor principal Adam Ant.
theaudiodb.biography_nl:
Adam and the Ants was een Britse New romantic-punkgroep, opgericht in 1977 in Londen, Engeland: Adam Ant (zang, gitaar), geboren als Stuart Leslie Goddard op 03-11-1954 in Marylebone, Londen, Engeland. Overige bandleden: Marco Pirroni (gitaar; ex Siouxsie & The Banshees), Kevin Mooney (basgitaar). Terry Lee Miall en Chris “Merrick” Hughes (beiden drums).

Mooney stapt op in 1981 en wordt vervangen door Gary Tibbs. De drie oorspronkelijke leden van de groep gitarist Matthew Ashman (overleden op 22-11-1995 aan de gevolgen van diabetes), bassist Leigh Gorman en drummer Dave Barbarossa formeren in januari 1980 de Britse new wave band Bow Wow Wow.

Adam Ant gaat vanaf 2 mei 1982 solo verder. Hij heeft dit besluit genomen nadat Miall en Tibbs zijn groep hebben verlaten. Acteert in de films Slam Dance (1987), World Gone Wild (1988) en is te zien in verschillende televisieseries.
theaudiodb.biography_pt: Adam and the Ants foi uma banda de rock britânica formada na cidade de Londres, em 1977 . O grupo original, que durou de 1977 a 1982, tornou-se notável durante a transição do punk rock do final da década de 1970 para o pós-punk e a new wave. Eram conhecidos por performances de palco abertamente sexualizadas e uso de tambores do Burundi. Dave Barbarossa, Matthew Ashman e Leigh Gorman, da primeira formação, deixaram a banda em janeiro de 1980, por sugestão do então empresário Malcolm McLaren, para formar a banda Bow Wow Wow. A segunda formação teve o guitarrista Marco Pirroni e o baterista/produtor musical Chris Hughes e foi de Fevereiro de 1980 a Março de 1982 e alcançou grande sucesso comercial no Reino Unido como primeiros líderes do movimento New Romantic. Ambas as formações foram lideradas pelo cantor e compositor Adam Ant.
